title: The SCO shall document with photographs or other means any violation of the code.
officialText:
The SCO shall submit an
interim report, to be submitted at the midpoint of the appointment period, and a final report to the department in the manner and form
prescribed by the commissioner. The department will share the results of these reports with the general contractor and provide the
general contractor an opportunity to comment.
